rationale: This is a motor vehicle collision resulting in major damage to the insured's vehicle and personal injury from the impact; clearly an auto claim.
claim_summary: Rear-end collision on Route 9 at red light. Insured vehicle (POL-1003) totaled with severe trunk damage; claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver at fault; police report on file with other driver's insurance information. High-severity incident requiring vehicle total-loss assessment and injury documentation.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: trunk crushed into back seat, vehicle totaled
case_facts.injury_party: claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist
case_facts.other_driver_report: police report filed with other driver's insurance information
